```plato

    // A central-difference estimate of the first derivative at t using step h.
    // Precondition: h > 0 and t +/- h stay in the domain of interest.
    SlopeAt(self: ICurve1D, t: Number, h: Number): Number
        => (self.Eval(t + h) - self.Eval(t - h)) / (2.0 * h);
```
